snippet.title: SpiritVale | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello! I’m Phil and I’ve been building SpiritVale, a class-based indie MMORPG inspired by Ragnarok Online and Project Return to Morroc.

Here to announce SpiritVale Kickstarter coming soon!

Follow us in Kickstarter to get notified when we launch https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiritvale/spiritvale

List of advancements available:
Wizard (Mage)
Shinobi (Rogue)
Priest (Acolyte)
Paladin (Knight)
Gunslinger (Scout)
Necromancer (Summoner)
Berserker (Warrior)
Weaver (All)

It's playable on Steam Playtest right now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3767850/SpiritVale/
Discord: https://discord.gg/spiritvale

When will Early Access arrive?
July 2026

Will there be a wipe?
Planned account wipe on Early Access release

Will there be auto play?
Never

Will it come to mobile?
Perhaps, after EA release

Will it be P2W?
No P2W, all progression is earned  

#MMORPG #IndieGame #WishlistOnSteam #SpiritVale
